name: Naengmyeon
description: Chewy buckwheat noodles in icy broth, sometimes with actual ice in the bowl.

tcm.note: Buckwheat is cool and descending; served with ice, this is the coldest dish in the set.

histamine.note: The broth is usually fermented dongchimi brine or beef stock; the vinegar and mustard add more.

nutrition.highlight: sometimes with ice in the bowl
